Sortie

Defender sallies out to strike an adjacent attacker supply hex. Severs the 'Supply Line' modifier and shaves 15 OP from the besieger's Buffer. Reinforce Garrison

Call Relief

Summon an allied relief force. Pushes a wave onto the siege that arrives in 2 turns; on arrival the GM convenes the Relief Scene (Phase E.3). Requires a willing ally. Target the besieged hex.

OP Cost: diplomacy 20, softPower 20

Tier: 2

Rarity: rare

Sue for Terms

Defender offers a negotiated surrender. The attacker may accept (won_sack) or refuse at next resolution (siege.resolveTerms). Target the besieged hex.

Tier: 2

Rarity: rare

Champion Defends Wall

A named defender Champion takes the wall: locked Active for 2 turns and +1 Anytime budget. Optional note {"championId":"..."} picks the champion; otherwise the first eligible. Target the besieged hex.

OP Cost: violence 10

Tier: 1

Rarity: uncommon

Pray for Omen

OP Cost: faith 10

Tier: 1

Rarity: uncommon

Champion Returns

OP Cost: diplomacy 20, softPower 10

Rarity: uncommon

Interdict Supply Line

Cut a supply-path hex feeding an enemy siege. Strips the hex's 'Supply Line' modifier (severs the route until restored) and lands an immediate harassment pulse: the besieger's Supply Buffer is shaved and per-turn attrition rises. Any faction except the besieger may interdict. Target the supply-road hex, not the besieged hex.

Sealed Pardon, Pre-Signed. A blank pardon with a real signature, sold to you by someone who will deny it to their grave. Fill in your own name. Move along.

Play: Clear your own Scandal flag (if any).

Forged Writ of Passage. The seal is real. The signature is real-adjacent. By the time anyone checks, you were demonstrably somewhere else, being charming.

Play: Lower Suspicion by 2.

The Wrong Twin. You introduce a small, load-bearing uncertainty about who, exactly, your opponent has been dealing with all evening.

Play: Your opponent must reroll their next exchange.

Buried Betrothal. A marriage promised before the Shattering, never formally dissolved. Wave it gently and watch a cold courtier suddenly find you fascinating.

Play: +2 favor with a courtier of your choice toward your side.

"Somebody has to stand where the trouble is."

Bravo is the Violence Calling — the trade that kept its bearers alive after the Shattering. Umbrella: guard, soldier, bandit, bouncer, duelist, caravan outrider. A profession is a flavor label on the Calling.

Knack — Shieldwall: Allies within reach add +1 Guard (+2 at Tier III). The Bravo is why the militia line holds.

Aptitude kit: signature aptitude Melee rank = tier; secondary Brawl rank = tier − 1.

Services: a standard job costs the tier fee (T1 10 / T2 30 / T3 90 / T4 270 marks), paid in Violence marks. Cross-pool ×1.5 friction applies as usual.

Tiers: Apprentice → Initiate → Master → Archon. Grant the matching tier features alongside this class item.

Awakens into: Aurablade or Bulwark. A Steward is a Calling that ignited into a Path — Surge is the mark of Stewardship, which is why no Calling banks or spends it.

Bravo — Apprentice (Tier I).

Trade — Stand a watch: Guard a person, door, or camp for a night/shift. Standard fee 10 marks (Violence).

Trick — Hold the Line (1/scene): When an adjacent ally is hit, the Bravo takes the hit instead.

Bravo — Initiate (Tier II).

Trade — Drill the green: Train a group; they count Trained (rank 1) in one Violence aptitude for the next scene that tests it. Standard fee 30 marks (Violence).

Trick — Disarming Blow (1/scene): On a hit, the target drops its weapon or takes −2 on its next strike.

Bravo — Master (Tier III).

Trade — Muscle for the job: Accompany one operation as a combatant (full stat participation). Standard fee 90 marks (Violence).

Trick — Veteran's Read (1/scene): Declare one enemy's next move aloud; all allies get +2 to defend against exactly that.

Master step: the Bravo's Knack (Shieldwall) improves at this tier — see the class entry.
